content:
CONFIRMED

- `MemoryHostStore.encode()` serializes the complete `document.snapshot().transcript()` into every durable snapshot payload: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-core\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\MemoryHostStore.java:567-596`.
- `LocalHostServer.snapshot()` retrieves and fully deserializes that payload into the REST response; its empty-payload fallback also loads the complete transcript: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-web\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\web\LocalHostServer.java:657-671`.
- The Stage 4 UI always fetches this snapshot when entering a session, then separately fetches the bounded timeline page: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\web\app\src\App.tsx:145-152,226-228`. The store retains the entire snapshot transcript: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\web\app\src\lib\session-store.ts:39-58`.
- The realistic CLI composition uses `PersistentHostStore` with SQLite: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\products\ji-cli\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\cli\JiCli.java:213-218`. A snapshot request reloads the persisted aggregate, and SQLite reads/decodes the full `document`, `snapshot_payload`, and retained `events_json` blobs: `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\applications\ji-host-core\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\PersistentHostStore.java:155-157,259-277`; `E:\Projects\Code\AI\Ji\ji-java\adapters\ji-host-sqlite\src\main\java\io\github\diodeme\ji\host\sqlite\SqliteHostStorePersistence.java:114-134`.

Thus opening a session initially or after Host restart still incurs transcript-sized storage reads, decoding, network transfer, and client retention despite the paginated timeline endpoint. Host boot alone does not eagerly load every session; the unbounded work occurs when restoring the selected session.
